empty.open: No market is open for bets right now; the next ones open at 00:00 UTC (your time).
empty.awaiting: No market is waiting for its result.
empty.proposed: No result is under dispute review right now.
group.dayBlurb: Markets open every day at 00:00 UTC (your time). “Daily” markets close 24 h later; “tomorrow” markets are on the next full UTC day, which nobody has seen yet.
group.weekBlurb: Run for a week; new ones open every Monday at 00:00 UTC (your time).
tl.snapshotNote: the hourly snapshot taken right after close; its hash goes on-chain
tl.voidNote: no result; every stake is refunded in full, no fee
tl.refundsNote: pushed to each wallet by the crank; nothing to claim
tl.proposeNote: the observed value and the evidence hash are on-chain; the winning range follows from the value
tl.proposeEst: the resolver runs hourly; proposes once the closing snapshot is verified against its on-chain hash
tl.finalNote: {h} h in which anyone can dispute the proposed result; then it is final
tl.payoutNote: winners are paid, losers' rent refunded, pushed by the crank; nothing to claim

srcl.store: Solana dApp Store API (first-party, off-chain), snapshot hash on-chain
m.sgt.cum: Increase in the number of Seeker Genesis Tokens between the opening baseline and the closing snapshot ({w}). Read from the token group size on the Genesis Token mint GT22…99Te. One soulbound token is minted per activated Seeker, so each unit is a $500 phone.
m.skr_staked.cum: Change in SKR held by the staking vault 8isV…ZbB8 ({w}).
m.skr_staked.med: {w} of hourly reads of the SKR staking vault 8isV…ZbB8, whose owner is re-verified against the staking program on every read. A median over the whole window cannot be moved by a last-minute deposit or withdrawal.
m.reviews.cum: Increase in the total number of reviews across every app in the Solana dApp Store ({w}), read directly from the store API. A review can only be written from a Seeker device, one per device per app, so every review is a phone acting.
m.dapps.cum: Increase in the number of apps listed in the Solana dApp Store ({w}), counted from the store catalog and deduplicated by package name.
m.dapps.med: {w} of the number of listed apps.
m.reviewers.level: wallets that reviewed in the last 7 days
m.reviewers.cum: Change in the number of distinct wallets that wrote a store review in the trailing 7 days ({w}).
m.reviewers.med: {w} of the number of distinct wallets that wrote a dApp Store review in the trailing 7 days. Reviews are device-gated, so each wallet is a phone.
m.skr_ids.cum: Increase in the number of .skr name records on-chain between the opening baseline and the closing snapshot ({w}), counted directly from the AllDomains name program.
m.das.med: {w} of seekertracker.com/api/das (IDs with ≥1 tx in 24h). Definition belongs to a third party.
m.ore_sol.cum: Total SOL deployed across every ORE mining round that finished {w}: the 25 squares of each round account of the ORE program (oreV3…LvWv), summed by our hourly snapshots as a running total, so the day's figure is close − open. Pushing this up costs real money: ORE returns only 89% of a losing square and 99% of a winning one, so every extra SOL deployed burns about 0.1 SOL.
m.ore_sol.med: {w} of the running total of SOL deployed in ORE rounds.
m.ore_hits.cum: Number of ORE rounds that finished {w} in which the motherlode paid out (round account field motherlode > 0). Whether a round hits is drawn from the round's on-chain randomness: nobody, not the ORE team, not us, can steer it. Recent rate: about one hit a day, and the pot (0.2 ORE added every round) grows until it hits.
m.ore_hits.med: {w} of the running count of motherlode hits.
m.ore_cost.cum: Change in the ORE program's production-cost EMA ({w}).
m.ore_cost.med: {w} of hourly reads of the ORE program's production-cost EMA (board account, lamports per ORE): what miners are currently paying per ORE, smoothed by the protocol itself. A median over the whole window cannot be moved by one heavy round.
m.skr_staked_med7.title: SKR staked (7-day median)
m.skr_staked_med7.how: Median of the 7 daily reads of the SKR staking vault 8isV…ZbB8, whose owner is re-verified against the staking program every day.
m.das_med7.title: Daily active Seekers (7-day median)
m.das_med7.how: Median of 7 daily reads of seekertracker.com/api/das (IDs with ≥1 tx in 24h). Definition belongs to a third party.
m.skr_price_close.title: SKR price at close
m.skr_price_close.how: Jupiter price v3 at the closing snapshot.
m.rev.title: New {app} reviews {w}
m.rev.how: Increase in {app}'s total dApp Store reviews between the opening baseline and the closing snapshot ({w}), read directly from the Solana dApp Store API. Reviews can only be written from a Seeker device, one per device per app, so each extra review costs a phone.
footer.times: All times are shown in your local time zone.
home.lead: Parimutuel pools on the numbers that describe the Seeker ecosystem. Winners split the losing pool; the protocol takes 3% of winnings only, less if you bet early, hold a Seeker Genesis Token or mine ORE. Every settlement is backed by hourly snapshots whose hashes are on-chain.
home.footer: Kubrai is a parimutuel pool, not an order book: your payout depends on the final pool sizes, not the odds at the time you bet. Settlement is permissionless and proposals can be disputed for 6 h before they become final.
title.home: Kubrai · bet on the Seeker numbers
lb.lead: One point per SKR staked in a market that paid out. Every range you bet counts, won or lost; voided markets score nothing.
inv.lead: Your link unlocks with your first bet. Friends who join through it get 10% of the fee on their winnings back; you earn 20% of it, rising to 30% as your points grow. Paid every Monday in SKR.
m.appCumHow: Resolves on the change between the opening hour's snapshot and the closing hour's ({w}).
m.appMedHow: Resolves on the {w} of every hourly reading inside the window.
m.nextHow: You bet on the number for the UTC day that starts when betting closes, so nobody has seen any of it yet. It is read {lag} days after that day ends; later revisions do not count. Ranges are cut at the quantiles of the source's last 84 days.
ev.dailyNotYet: not published yet (read {lag} days after the day ends)
